transcript.speaker: Northern Rumor
transcript.text: Word of your silver tongue spreads swiftly across the frozen reaches.

transcript.speaker: Discovery
transcript.text: Keen eyes uncover relics buried beneath centuries of mountain frost.

transcript.speaker: Artisan Chronicle
transcript.text: Runes hum warmly along your newly forged work.

transcript.speaker: Fieldcraft
transcript.text: Careful northern preparation pays off in deadly efficiency.

transcript.speaker: World Update
transcript.text: With the mountain frost troll defeated, the Grimstone silver shafts breathe easier.

transcript.speaker: World Update
transcript.text: The ancient draugr curse lifts from the Weeping Barrow Stones as Chieftain Skallagrim crumbles to dust.

transcript.speaker: Historic Victory
transcript.text: The sky-shattering roar of Vyr fades forever across the glacier peaks! Mount Wyrmfang grows silent.

transcript.speaker: Mira Cold-Spring
transcript.text: Seeing you defied the Whispering Cabal, Mira slides a salt-stained wax seal across the bar in silence: 'They are moving Vyr-cult obsidian idols up the Sunken Mire Causeway under a Watch traitor's seal. Haul the submerged buoy at dusk.'

addJournalMysteries.title: Ashes of the Broken Oath
addJournalMysteries.text: Mira Cold-Spring revealed that Vyr cultists are smuggling obsidian relics through Mistglen's sunken causeway.

transcript.speaker: Morrigan the Peat-Mother
transcript.text: Morrigan studies your eyes over her simmering cauldron. 'You stayed your hand against my sister's boy Malik when any sell-sword would have claimed his head. Hear a secret older than King Valen: beneath the Howling Timber Cavern lies a Drakenseeker cairn holding the Frost-Truce Tablet.'

addJournalMysteries.title: The Mercy of the Drowned
addJournalMysteries.text: Morrigan revealed that Malik was framed by Valenfrost nobles and entrusted you with the location of a hidden Drakenseeker cairn in Howling Timber Cavern.

transcript.speaker: Skald Einar
transcript.text: Skald Einar lowers his harp and draws you behind a timber pillar. 'Valenfrost's own blood stains the snow, and you have walked Skallagrim's barrow. Hear the verse no Jarl allows sung: High King Valen betrayed Chieftain Skallagrim for the third Star-Key and walled the true Rime-King's Crown inside Frostmere Archives!'

addJournalMysteries.title: Blood Upon the Frost-Throne
addJournalMysteries.text: Skald Einar confessed that High King Valen betrayed Skallagrim and hid the Crown of the Rime-King behind a false wall in Frostmere Archives.
